final: WITH station_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM station_counts), overall AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(telescope_count) AS avg_telescope_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS avg_share_above_average FROM shares CROSS JOIN overall WHERE share > average_share
